units.source_text: 重叠起无数的化石层，跨越而来，人类的痉挛……

en.t: Humanity's convulsion, crossing over through countless piled-up fossil layers...

units.source_text: 生殖推进机大叫着，狂喜地进发，恐龙的牙齿也好，冰河的壁障也好，谁也挡不住……

en.t: The reproductive engine screamed and advanced in ecstasy; neither dinosaur teeth nor the walls of glaciers, nothing could hold it back...

units.source_text: 不久，扭动着身体，竭尽全力，发射出白鱼子似的焰火……

en.t: Before long, writhing its body and straining with all its might, it shot out fireworks like white fish roe...

units.source_text: 穿过无限的幽暗，迸发出来的流星群……

en.t: A swarm of meteors bursting forth through infinite darkness...
